The Crewlet Operator ({{ .Chart.Name }}) is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} as release {{ .Release.Name }}.

Check that the manager runs (one replica holds the leader lease, the others
wait to take over):

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl api-resources --api-group=crewlet.ai

Next, create an EngineClass, the defaults and limits your companies run with,
and a Company:

  https://docs.crewlet.ai/operator/latest/getting-started/

The ClusterRole {{ include "crewlet-operator.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "tenant-provisioner" "context" $) }} is installed for the control plane that provisions tenants
{{- if .Values.tenantProvisioner.subjects }}, and bound to the subjects in tenantProvisioner.subjects.
{{- else }}; bind it to your control plane's identity.
